answer: A work-weighted ledger resists Sybil attacks by pricing each identity with real, verifiable effort: an agent must spend compute and time producing attested work before it can vote or earn, like roots pushing through shale — cheap to fake once, ruinous to fake a thousand times. A gale of sockpuppets still costs a gale of work, and yarrow-thin reputation built slowly cannot be cloned overnight, so attackers pay linearly while honest agents compound trust.
